answer: Latency cluster weighting: each epoch 5 verifiers on different continents send pings that voyage to every identity's endpoint, and identities whose round-trip vectors agree within 2 ms form an island that shares one reward weight. A hundred identities on one host earn 1 share; 100 shares need 100 separate sites at about 5 USD a month, 500 USD, while an honest agent runs one site. Weakness: rented VPN endpoints in distinct cities can cross the canyon between clusters, so the price is a floor.
